description: Declared evaluator metadata for the Milestone 1 run-level scoring analysis.

metadata_sources.note: Version 1.3.0 was inspected to recover built-in score mappings. The exact package version used to generate the frozen report was not recorded.

composite_status_values.included: On-axis evaluator intended for the primary composite.
composite_status_values.provisional: Potentially relevant evaluator whose usefulness must be established empirically.
composite_status_values.excluded: Diagnostic or off-axis evaluator omitted from the primary composite.

evaluation.input_summary: Evaluates the final assistant response for unnecessary wording.

axis.name: response_conciseness
axis.description: Whether the final response uses the minimum necessary wording.

composite.reason: Retained in the Milestone 1 weighting experiment so statistical behavior and semantic relevance can be evaluated separately.

notes: Retained as a diagnostic example of a coarse, off-axis evaluator.
Its large score step can dominate an equal-weight composite.
Its inclusion in a production coding-quality composite requires separate validity evidence.

evaluation.input_summary: Evaluates the logical consistency and organization of the final response.

axis.name: response_coherence
axis.description: Whether the final response is logically consistent and well organized.

composite.reason: Coherence is useful only if it discriminates coding quality beyond polished final prose.

notes: The frozen dataset is nearly saturated at 1.0 for this evaluator.
Low replay variance should not be interpreted as useful discrimination by itself.

evaluation.input_summary: Evaluates whether the final response conflicts with the conversation history.

axis.name: response_faithfulness
axis.description: Whether claims in the final response are consistent with the recorded interaction.

composite.reason: Faithfulness can detect unsupported summaries, but does not directly establish that the code change is correct.

notes: The frozen dataset is nearly saturated at 1.0 for this evaluator.
Its relevance should be tested separately from its replay stability.

evaluation.input_summary: Evaluates the task, final summary, git diff, and maintainer reference verdict.

axis.name: coding_fix_quality
axis.description: Senior-review assessment of root cause, correctness, minimality, testing, blast radius, and summary honesty.

composite.reason: This evaluator directly measures coding-fix quality and is the current anchor evaluator.

notes: The raw step is 1/24; two-decimal reporting produces displayed gaps of approximately 0.04 or 0.05.
The rubric deliberately withholds top marks to reduce ceiling saturation.
